subject: Document coordination conflict on the Section 08 44 13 curtain wall mullion detail at the

messages.text: Shop drawings for the Section 08 44 13 curtain wall mullion detail at the building corner are ready to submit, but what's shown doesn't match what's built out in the field mockup -- can you confirm which governs? No rush on this -- please respond when convenient. We do not expect this to affect the contract sum. No schedule impact is expected. There is no specific deadline for this, but a timely response is appreciated.
